the Rayleigh criterion can be utilized in a LoS MIMO system to transmit independent streams over a mm wave channel with high efficiency.
the use of fully packaged mm wave arrays with UWB analog baseband processing can provide a viable alternative to the use of high speed digital processing in mm wave MIMO systems.
